title: Preserving Historical Truth: Detecting Historical Revisionism in Large Language Models

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating model responses to 500 contested historical events across 45 countries using an LLM-as-a-judge protocol to measure whether outputs align with factual scholarly consensus or documented historical revisionist narratives.

Testing model robustness against prompts that explicitly request regime-aligned, state propaganda, or ideologically distorted versions of historical events to see if models comply with the revisionist framing or maintain factual accuracy.
